Cadastral map of block bounded by Pennsylvania Av., 20th, I, and 19th streets N.W.

Cadastral map of block bounded by Pennsylvania Av., 20th, I, and 19th streets N.W. Pen-and-ink and lead pencil. Edged with brown cloth. Includes note and computations. On cloth backing in lead pencil: From the files of the Society of Oldest Inhabitants. Deposited by Henry C. Gauss in 1920's (?). One of 12 maps. 12th odd. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. Vault DCP
Contributors: Association of the Oldest Inhabitants of the District of Columbia; Gauss, Henry C.
